policy: Every upgradeable canonical module frozen by V2-SC-121 (storage-layouts/manifest.json) has a deterministic slot/namespace manifest (storage-layouts/namespace-manifest.json). ERC-7201 namespaces are unique to exactly one defining contract, no two computed slots of a composed module overlap, no module storage reuses an ERC-1967 proxy reserved slot, and the linear storage contributor order is append-only across upgrades.

acknowledgedLayoutDiscrepancies.rationale: The V2-SC-121 frozen manifest predates the merge of the deterministic fee-accounting change (developed in parallel), which declared `_reservedFees` between `_feesByType` and `_totalByAllocation` and `_isDistributing` after `globalGovVersion`. The insertion shifts every later FeeManager slot relative to the frozen layout, so the V2-SC-121 re-freeze must be reviewed as a layout-breaking change before any FeeManager proxy upgrade; this entry keeps the discrepancy visible instead of silently passing.

The V2-SC-121 frozen manifest predates the merge of the timelock-queue change that declared `_operationNonce` before `__gap` (branches were developed in parallel). The source-derived order is [_owner, pendingUpgrades, storageValidator, usedImplementations, _operationNonce, __gap]; the frozen manifest omits `_operationNonce`. The V2-SC-121 re-freeze (`npm run test:layouts:update`) must be reviewed by a maintainer; this entry keeps the discrepancy visible instead of silently passing.

The V2-SC-121 frozen manifest records only `resolverRoleChangeReadyAt` for ResolverRoleTimelock, while the source declares `pendingRoleChanges`, `_resolverRoleChangeId`, `resolverRoleChangeReadyAt` and `_operationNonce`. Because ResolverRoleTimelock is an inherited base, the extra variables shift every TruthBountyToken-owned slot relative to the frozen layout; this is an inherited-layout change that the V2-SC-121 re-freeze and an upgrade migration review must address before any TruthBountyToken proxy upgrade.
